title: Has anyone here actually used Chronos-9? Legit or scam?
author: Big-Jeweler-668
selftext:
Hi everyone,  
I’m looking into Chronos-9 (https://chronos9.com/), which sells an AI bot that predicts the 15-minute Bitcoin market on Kalshi.

The website claims a prediction accuracy of 72%+, and the owner has posted on Discord that they’re expecting to improve it to around 80% with upcoming updates.

The problem is that I genuinely can’t tell whether this is a legitimate product or a scam.  
One thing that makes me cautious is that the Discord has 750+ members, but it seems like it’s mostly the same handful of people commenting and sharing results.  
Has anyone here actually used the bot?

Thanks!
